item.title: Maleh to launch Dithapelo album with live concert in Joburg
item.description: Lesotho-born singer and songwriter Maleh has announced a live album launch concert for her latest release, Dithapelo, scheduled to take place at Johannesburg’s Market Theatre on 28 March. The performance will mark the first full live presentation of Dithapelo, an album released in November 2025 that reflects themes of faith, reflection and spiritual renewal. item.title: SA: Hxdi Stross shares new single Nakwela
item.description: Pretoria-based artist and video producer Hxdi Stross has released a new single titled ‘Nakwela’, marking a shift in his musical direction and creative approach. Known for his work in the dance and hip hop space, Hxdi Stross introduces a more restrained Afro-influenced sound on ‘Nakwela’. item.title: TikTok plans shift to per-play Music pay-outs, according to industry sources
item.description: TikTok is preparing to revise its long-criticised music royalty payment system, with plans to introduce pay-outs based on the number of times a video is played rather than a single payment per video, according to information shared with Digital Music News (DMN). Under TikTok’s existing model, rights holders are typically paid only once for the initial use of a song in a video, regardless of how many times that video is viewed. item.title: Mr Eazi, King Promise share new single That Way
item.description: GRAMMY Award-winning artist Mr Eazi and Afro-pop singer King Promise have released a new joint single titled ‘That Way’, marking their second collaboration in less than a year. item.title: DJY Spetla: Beats, business, and legacy
item.description: By Tshifhiwa Mungoni and Sibongile Kobo Nhlanhla Phiri, known professionally as DJY Spetla, is a South African DJ, producer and entrepreneur whose work spans music production, business and community initiatives. item.title: Ghanaian highlife legend Ebo Taylor dead at 90
item.description: Ghanaian highlife musician and composer Ebo Taylor died on 7 February at the age of 90. His family confirmed the news, although the cause of death had not been disclosed at the time of publication. Taylor’s passing comes six years after he received the Music In Africa Honorary Award at the opening of the Music In Africa Conference for Collaborations, Exchange and Showcases (ACCES) in Accra on 28 November 2019. item.title: Downtown Music Publishing Africa partners Arms Productions Music
item.description: Downtown Music Publishing Africa has entered a partnership with Arms Productions Music, a boutique production music company specialising in human-made, original compositions for film, television, and digital media. item.title: Spotify launches audiobooks in South Africa
item.description: Spotify has expanded its services in South Africa with the introduction of audiobooks on its platform, allowing users to listen to book titles alongside music and podcasts within the same app. The audiobook catalogue includes a range of bestsellers, new releases and genre titles. item.title: Warner Music Group reports Q4 revenue growth as net income declines
item.description: Warner Music Group (WMG) reported a year-on-year increase in revenue for the fourth quarter of 2025, alongside a decline in net income, according to its latest financial results. The company generated $1.84 billion in revenue during the three months to the end of 2025, representing a 10.4% increase compared with the same period a year earlier. item.title: Sony Music posts double-digit revenue growth in Q4 2025
item.description: Sony Music Group recorded a double-digit increase in revenue during the fourth quarter of 2025, supported by gains across physical formats, merchandise and music publishing, according to Sony Group Corporation’s latest earnings report. For the three months from October to December 2025, Sony Group reported external music revenue of ¥538.66 billion ($3.43 billion).
